REEL DOWNLOADER, MADE FOR INDIA

• Reels downloader that just works — paste link, tap, saved
• Video downloader and video saver in one clean app

• Download videos in MP4 format — plays in any media player
• Save reels offline — watch later, even without internet

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

HOW TO SAVE A REEL IN 3 STEPS

1. Copy the reel link from your favorite social app (Share → Copy link)
2. Open ReelSave — your link auto-fills in the paste field
3. Tap Download. Your reel is saved straight to Gallery → Pictures/ReelSave

That's it. No accounts, no waiting, no extra steps. The fastest reels downloader experience on Android.
